```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments
```

**Headers**

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `x-apikey` | `ABC321` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` |

**Body**

```json
{
  "type": "comment",
  "attributes": {
    "text": "Confirmed #malware"
  }
}
```

**Curl example**

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
           "type": "comment",
           "attributes": {
             "text": "Confirmed #malware"
           }
         }'
```

If you run that command (or use a similar HTTP client in your preferred language), VirusTotal should add the comment to the IP record and return a JSON response confirming the creation. Let me know if you need help interpreting the response or automating this in a script!
